data.why: The app loads ./data/electronic_features.csv and ./data/questionnaire.xlsx itself from the repo at startup, no upload is involved; seed/app.py replaces the repo's app.py to call app.run(...) instead of the removed app.run_server(...) in modern Dash.

goals: Explore how electronic features (EA*, S1-T1 gap, exciton binding energy) relate to hydrogen evolution rate across candidate photocatalyst molecules in the 5D explorer
Identify clusters of structurally or electronically similar molecules in the 2D chemical space view
Inspect the 3D structure of a selected candidate molecule after clicking a point in the scatter plot
Compare machine-learning model predictions against experimental hydrogen evolution rates in the blind-test validation plot
Take the HER prediction challenge link to compare human intuition against the model on held-out candidates

review.summary: The tree describes the three views and the structure viewer accurately, with sound evidence, and correctly declines to invent the predicted-vs-experiment plot that the plan expected. It should not be filed until the pick-to-structure task and feature stop presenting a bug workaround and wrong IDs as the workflow, phase 1 is merged into fewer, coarser tasks, and the prediction challenge and multi-structure selection are added.
